selection.rule: Published modules marked first-party-functional-candidate or mixed bundle, JavaScript extensions; literal rg selection precedes AST parsing; only matching files parsed

receiverResolution.claim: Reviewed import/export, argument, construction and registry locators establish a static prediction-fork path; dynamic receiver identity and backend execution are not established.

limitations: Published bundle ownership is a first-party functional candidate or mixed bundle classification, not a claim that every contained statement is first-party.
Only the literal-matching candidate files are parsed; strings constructed dynamically, unselected dependencies, and non-JavaScript implementations are outside this supplement.
No receiver identity is inferred from a same-named forkThread method.
No backend, model, login, or application runtime is executed.

reviewedFindings.claim: main i.dt resolves through the literal src require and src exports.dt getter to Rq; fge passes client:e and experimentalPredictionMode:true.

Rq destructures experimentalPredictionMode as S=false. Under sourceThreadId availability and h.forkThread presence, S selects h.forkThread({threadId:u,experimentalPredictionMode:true,ephemeral:true,excludeTurns:true,threadSource:f}); this is an actual call argument, not a generated type declaration.

Rq forwards S into kn. kn destructures the flag as f=false and reads f in c.startTurn arguments: true selects {effort:p}; false selects the explicit cwd/read-only/model/serviceTier/summary/personality/collaborationMode overrides. No field named experimentalPredictionMode is emitted in this startTurn argument.
fge returns null when r.Ti(e.appServerVersion,"experimentalPredictionForkMode") is false. The implementation/threshold of r.Ti is outside the two matching parsed files and is not inferred.

src mB.forkThread constructs this.sendInternalRequest({method:"thread/fork",params:{...e,threadSource:...}}), preserving ordinary incoming fields through the spread. This defines a concrete candidate sender; no actual invocation or backend receipt is observed.

main factory constructs new i.pn, and src exports.pn returns mB. The prediction manager receives a registry, chooses a connection with getConnection(hostId), and forwards it through fge/Rq. Registration/factory/lookup locators are retained. Dynamic host lookup, external mutations and the concrete runtime receiver remain unknown; same-named external-import and voice-title wrappers are not treated as this receiver.
